name: Fallout: New Vegas
quirks: The 4GB patch is built into xNVSE; no separate patcher needed.

Luma keeps plugins.txt in step with your mods while they're in the game: plugins (.esp/.esm/.esl) of enabled mods are turned on, masters first, in your mod order. Turn single plugins off under Plugins. The game orders plugins by file date, which Luma sets.
Archive invalidation (for replaced textures) is turned on in Fallout.ini while mods are in; start the game once first so the file exists.
